ingredients.name: Ground Hot Italian Sausage
ingredients.notes: Use 1/2 hot and 1/2 mild if you don't like spicy.

ingredients.name: Heavy Cream
ingredients.notes: Can substitute whole milk, half and half, etc.

instructions.text: Turn the Instant Pot to Sauté mode, and add the chopped bacon. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the bacon renders out most of its fat. Remove and set aside.
Add the sausage and brown it, stirring a few times. If you can get a good browning on it the flavor will be even better!
Spoon out most of the fat, leaving about 1 tablespoon.
When the onions start to turn translucent, add the garlic and stir.
Pour in the broth, stirring, and scrape the bottom of the pot to remove the browned bits.
Add the potatoes and add the bacon back in.
Check to make sure the contents do not go over the Max Fill line marked on the inner liner.
Close the lid and set the steam release knob to Sealing.
Set to Manual or Pressure Cook and choose 5 minutes at High Pressure.
After the cooking cycle ends, allow a 10 minute Natural Pressure Release.
Do a Controlled Quick Release for the remaining steam. When the pin in the lid drops, open the lid.
Add the kale, or thawed spinach if using, and stir well. Cover and let heat through for about 5 minutes to soften the kale. If using spinach, stir it in and proceed to the next step.
